title: Superb Sea Lanterns
description: This resource pack replaces the sea lantern texture with a version that has a smoother transition between blocks.
body: This resource pack redesigns the sea lantern texture to include a subtle, integrated border that softens the edges between blocks. Inspired by the natural blending effect of the shroomlight, this change reduces the harsh, grid-like appearance of the original texture. The result is a smoother, more polished look that blends seamlessly in builds while preserving the sea lantern’s bright, clean glow. Perfect for players who want improved visual continuity without altering the block’s overall style or function.
